scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.seed.json
scripts.test: pnpm db:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js && tsx --test prisma/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: pnpm db:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/health.test.js && tsx --test prisma/demo-fixtures.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: node -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_TEST_URL) throw Error('DATABASE_TEST_URL é obrigatória para integração')" && pnpm db:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/prisma.integration.test.js && tsx --test prisma/demo-fixtures.integration.test.ts
